mentions.name: Quillium
mentions.description: A nonlinear writing editor that tracks versions of individual words, paragraphs, sentences, and drafts, letting writers compare and manage revisions without juggling duplicate files.
mentions.problem: Keeping track of essay draft versions without filename-based chaos like Final_FINAL_v3_essay.docx
mentions.source_excerpt:
I was able to polish up Quillium (https://quillium.bryanhu.com) so I can dogfood it for my college applications.

It's a nonlinear writing editor, so I can keep track of all the versions of different words, paragraphs, sentences, or drafts. No more Final_FINAL_v3_essay.docx
